_provenance: All values are illustrative assumptions from the HeadwayIQ concept PDF. None are verified BMTC data.

headway.nominal_peak_headway_note: Nominal scheduled service headway (720 seconds = 12 minutes) during peak periods across all scheduled departure slots.
headway.nominal_offpeak_headway_note: Nominal scheduled service headway (900 seconds = 15 minutes) during off-peak periods.
headway.bunching_threshold_note: Configurable default — no official BMTC source. Two consecutive operating buses at the same stop and direction within this interval trigger a bunching alert.
headway.large_gap_note: A headway exceeding (nominal_scheduled_headway × this multiplier) is flagged as a large gap.

crowding.overcrowding_note: Percentage of vehicle capacity_total above which a warning crowding alert fires (100% = passenger load equals total vehicle design capacity).
crowding.severe_overcrowding_note: Occupancy at 150% of configured capacity (e.g. 90 passengers on a 60-passenger capacity bus). Derived from the infographic's source-pending 150%-200% overcapacity claim. It represents 1.5× design capacity, not 150% above capacity (which would be 250% load), and is an illustrative threshold, not an independently verified BMTC statistic.

dispatch_control.max_delay_note: Maximum cumulative delay permitted on a bus before hold recommendations are rejected or capped.
dispatch_control.min_viable_hold_note: Minimum hold duration worth issuing to a driver.

simulator_defaults.cycle_time_note: Illustrative round-trip cycle time assumption (55 min outbound + 10 min recovery at Hebbal + 55 min inbound + 10 min recovery at Silk Board = 130 min) for Silk Board ↔ Hebbal. Used to estimate physical fleet requirements.

financial.fare_revenue_note: Illustrative assumption from HeadwayIQ concept PDF — not verified BMTC data.
financial.revenue_uplift_note: Illustrative assumption — not a validated outcome.
financial.cost_per_bus_hour_note: Placeholder — exact value not available from the concept PDF.
financial.trips_per_hour_note: Placeholder — exact value not available from the concept PDF.

pricing.price_note: Proposed commercial assumption, not a validated customer price.
pricing.example_fleet_note: Arithmetic example based on the price assumption (1,000 buses × Rs 1,200 = Rs 12,00,000/month), not a customer commitment or revenue forecast.
